# Data Source: stripe_billing_feedback_option

A reason a customer can pick when canceling a subscription.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_billing_feedback_option" "too_expensive" {
  id = stripe_billing_feedback_option.too_expensive.id
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the billing feedback option to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `description` - The text of the feedback option, which customers see when canceling. Maximum 100 characters.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `status` - The feedback option's status. Possible values: `active`, `inactive`.
* `status_transitions` - See [`status_transitions`](#status_transitions) below.

<a id="status_transitions"></a>
### `status_transitions`

The `status_transitions` attribute supports:

* `deactivated_at` - The time the feedback option was deactivated, if any. Measured in seconds since Unix epoch.
